Step 3: Because space is limited to 7 participants, a small cohort will be selected to join us for the September 10th kickoff.    The Ideal Candidate & Commitment:  This program is designed for Norfolk residents who already have some basic crafting or jewelry-making experience and are interested in moving beyond a casual hobby.  Participants must be able to commit to attending all 12 bi-weekly sessions (Thursday evenings, 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM, Sept 10, 2026 – Feb 25, 2027).

items.summary: Invest 24 hours in yourself to change the rest of your life! The ARTisan Academy is a vocational pathway to creative entrepreneurship. Learn how to create adorned jewelry and birth a micro business.      Interested in taking your jewelry making to the next level and exploring what it takes to launch a local brand?  The Artisan Academy 757 is a hands-on, 6-month program for creative jewelry makers looking to refine their skills and move towards small business start-up.  Over 12 bi-weekly sessions, we will cover the fundamentals of jewelry design, collection planning, and the basics of setting up a compliant micro-business in the City of Norfolk.    How It Works:  Step 1:Register your interest on this page.  Step 2: Check your email in early August for a short follow-up questionnaire.  Step 3: Because space is limited to 7 participants, a small cohort will be selected to join us for the September 10th kickoff.    The Ideal Candidate & Commitment:  This program is designed for Norfolk residents who already have some basic crafting or jewelry-making experience and are interested in moving beyond a casual hobby.  Participants must be able to commit to attending all 12 bi-weekly sessions (Thursday evenings, 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM, Sept 10, 2026 – Feb 25, 2027).

The Artisan Academy 757 is a hands-on, 6-month program for creative jewelry makers looking to refine their skills and move towards small business start-up.  Over 12 bi-weekly sessions, we will cover the fundamentals of jewelry design, collection planning, and the basics of setting up a compliant micro-business in the City of Norfolk.    How It Works:  Step 1:Register your interest on this page.  Step 2: Check your email in early August for a short follow-up questionnaire.  Step 3: Because space is limited to 7 participants, a small cohort will be selected to join us for the September 10th kickoff.    The Ideal Candidate & Commitment:  This program is designed for Norfolk residents who already have some basic crafting or jewelry-making experience and are interested in moving beyond a casual hobby.  Participants must be able to commit to attending all 12 bi-weekly sessions (Thursday evenings, 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM, Sept 10, 2026 – Feb 25, 2027).
